notes: GAAP city (FY ending 2023-12-31). Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p6); ending_cash/ending_investments from the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p5); beginning cash not printed. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position total column (p9); operating charges for services 231,924,054 split by activity using the Statement of Activities business-type charges for services (p3), which add exactly; Printing and graphics and River Front Plaza had no charges. Business-type reported disbursements = Statement of Activities total business-type expenses 143,071,786 (p3) = operating expenses + interest expense (p9). Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (pp1-2), Governmental and Business-type columns; totals from the Total column. Detail: budgetary comparison schedules (budgetary basis) for the General Fund (pp12-13), Street and Highway Allocation, Judgment, Library Fine and Fees, Douglas County Library Supplement, Keno/Lottery Proceeds, Storm Water Fee Revenue, City Street Maintenance, Interceptor Sewer Construction, Community Park Development, State Turn Back Revenue, Ballpark Revenue, Keno/Lottery Reserve, Greater Omaha Convention and Visitors Bureau, Destination Marketing Corporation, Household Chemical Disposal, Development Revenue, Debt Service and Riverfront Redevelopment Special Tax funds (pp14-33). Lines with no actual amount (dash) were skipped. Grants fund and proprietary funds have no budget schedule in the trim, so no per-fund detail lines are added for them. The trim skips report pages between some schedules (e.g. report pp97-99, 147-149); pp15-16 (pension RSI) and pp34-36 (statistical tables) hold no receipts/disbursements. Read pages 1-36 of 36
